runner: node <test-file>.test.js (no test framework/package.json in this repo; each *.test.js is a standalone Node script using assert + vm, matching the existing repo convention)

cases.name: base detection, WITH a CUENTAS (AM Intelligence) match and no contradictions -> DETECTED
cases.guarantee: normal-case automation: a Retention signal with AM Intelligence context and no AM-activity red flags is never suppressed by default

cases.name: Sin dueno / house account -> SUPPRESSED / OWNER REQUIRED (regression), CUENTAS branch never touched
cases.guarantee: suppression: pre-existing owner-required rule still wins first and short-circuits before any new join logic runs

cases.name: cross-priority suppression (QNB beats Retention for the same account) -> HIGHER PRIORITY SIGNAL
cases.guarantee: suppression: shared v6ApplyPrioritySuppression_ still enforces one active family per account after adding the CUENTAS join

cases.name: bucket confirms genuine absence of management, no contradiction -> DETECTED
cases.guarantee: normal-case automation: AM-activity evidence that clearly confirms no management does not block automated retention outreach

cases.name: ambiguous bucket ('8. GESTIONADAS SIN OPERAR') -> SUPPRESSED / AM ACTIVITY REVIEW REQUIRED, and v6PipelineWinner_/v6PipelineSyncSignals_ route it to CLOSED / SUPPRESSED like any other suppressed row
cases.guarantee: suppression + duplicate prevention: an ambiguous AM-activity signal never leaks into the active pipeline through the idempotent bulk pipeline sync

cases.name: bucket says 'no management' but Tipo gestion says COMERCIAL (contradiction) -> SUPPRESSED / AM ACTIVITY REVIEW REQUIRED
cases.guarantee: suppression: contradictory AM-activity evidence is flagged for human review instead of silently auto-detected or auto-suppressed

cases.name: row with no CUENTAS (AM Intelligence) match at all -> SUPPRESSED / AM CONTEXT REQUIRED, join coverage metric reflects partial match
cases.guarantee: canonical architecture: AURA never advances a NOVA-only signal to DETECTED by skipping AM Intelligence; a missing AM Intelligence record fails closed, and join coverage remains an observability metric on top of that gate, never a substitute for it

cases.name: REPLY -> pipeline RESPONDED, nextAction STOP ACCOUNT AUTOMATION / V5.5 HANDOFF, handoffStatus PENDING
cases.guarantee: stop + handoff: a real commercial reply stops account automation and creates an AM handoff via the existing pipeline stage machine

cases.name: RFQ -> pipeline RFQ RECEIVED with rfqAt set
cases.guarantee: response capture correctly advances pipeline stage for qualifying commercial activity

cases.name: BOUNCE -> MKT_CONTACTS_SECURE emailStatus INVALID via read-merge-upsert, historical fields preserved, pipeline untouched
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention / idempotent UPSERT (merge-by-contactId, never blind overwrite) and isolation (a delivery failure does not affect account pipeline state)

cases.name: UNSUBSCRIBE -> MKT_EXCLUSIONS ACTIVE exclusion with deterministic exclusionId, pipeline untouched
cases.guarantee: suppression / DNC governance: an unsubscribe becomes a durable, idempotent exclusion (re-processing the same event does not duplicate the exclusion row) without altering pipeline stage

cases.name: CLICK / OTHER / unrecognized eventType -> action IGNORED, zero writes to any table
cases.guarantee: normal-case automation: non-qualifying engagement events never trigger a stop, handoff, exclusion, or contact mutation

cases.name: resolves accountId via MKT_ACCOUNTS crosswalk and writes attributedRevenue exactly equal to Monto
cases.guarantee: attribution: revenue is copied as-is from the authoritative source, never recalculated, never summed with unrelated figures

cases.name: no unique MKT_ACCOUNTS match (unknown account) -> no pipeline write, unresolvedCount increments
cases.guarantee: never join by account name without an authoritative crosswalk; fail-closed on ambiguous/absent identity instead of guessing

cases.name: account present by name but missing salesforceAccountId/externalAccountId -> unresolved
cases.guarantee: canonical Salesforce Account ID or documented 1:1 mapping is mandatory before attribution writes anything

cases.name: existing pipeline record already has a campaignId and is past CAMPAIGN ACTIVE -> nextAction marks MULTI-CAMPAIGN CONCURRENCY, campaignId is not overwritten
cases.guarantee: attribution ambiguity is surfaced explicitly instead of silently reassigning campaign credit

cases.name: v6AuraEvaluateRetention_ aggregates DETECTED/SUPPRESSED/reviewRequired by reason and automatically builds campaign scope only for DETECTED accounts
cases.guarantee: detect -> suppress -> build scope runs as one automatic, no-manual-list unit; suppressed/review-required accounts are never scoped

cases.name: v6AuraAutoBuildRetentionScopes_ groups by (amOwner, service), excludes suppressed rows and other opportunity families
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention + family isolation: a Retention scope build can never include a non-Retention account or a suppressed Retention account

cases.name: v6AuraStatus_ returns safe consolidated status (pipeline stage, Retention signal, audience status once a campaign is linked); no PII fields
cases.guarantee: AURA never surfaces accountName/email/contact PII through a status query, only aggregate/status fields

cases.name: v6AuraEnsureCampaignScope_ is idempotent: re-running with an added account merges into the existing scope row, never duplicates it
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention: repeated scheduler runs against the same scope never create parallel scope/scope-account rows

cases.name: v6AuraCreateAccountStop_ closes a fresh account to CLOSED / SUPPRESSED; an account already at QUOTED keeps that stage (preventDowngrade) while nextAction/handoffStatus still update
cases.guarantee: account stop never erases evidence that a Quote/Load already happened, while still recording the stop/handoff intent

cases.name: v6AuraCreateAmHandoff_ preserves the account's current pipeline stage and refuses to run with no existing pipeline record
cases.guarantee: AM handoff never resets an already-advanced stage back to OPPORTUNITY DETECTED and never fabricates a pipeline context that doesn't exist

cases.name: v6ClassifyResponseEvent_ accepts QUOTE/LOAD as aliases of QUOTE_SIGNAL/LOAD_SIGNAL (case-insensitive) and only sets attributedRevenue on LOAD when the raw event explicitly supplies an amount
cases.guarantee: the exact event vocabulary requested (REPLY, RFQ, BOUNCE, UNSUBSCRIBE, CLICK, QUOTE, LOAD) is accepted without a second, divergent code path, and revenue is never fabricated on a real-time event

regressionCoverage.description: Full existing suite re-run after every change in this branch, most recently after the AURA Retention Bridge pass.
regressionCoverage.verification: git stash of all Retention V1 changes + re-run reproduced the identical 7 failures on main before any change in this branch, confirming they are unrelated (stale index.html cache-busting version strings and V5.5 frontend/backend-adapter assertions). Re-verified after the AURA Retention Bridge pass: same 7 files, same failure reason (e.g. v6-report-ingestion.test.js still fails on the same stale 'marketing-opportunity-engine-v6.js?v=20260827-1' assertion), pass/fail counts moved only by the 4 new Retention/AURA test files added across this branch (13 -> 14 passed after this pass's 1 new file; 7 fail is unchanged throughout).
